name: codegate
description: Run configured repository checks on demand and install Git hooks per repository.

interface.longDescription: CodeGate runs the tests, lint and type checks declared in codegate.toml for a local Git repository and reports what failed. Set up repositories individually, run checks on demand, and use Git hooks to check ordinary commits and pushes. Requires Python 3.11+ and a local desktop Codex thread with repository access. Configured commands run with your local permissions and can access the network. A passing check does not prove the code is bug-free, and local hooks can be bypassed; use required CI checks for server-side enforcement.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeGate in this repository.
Run CodeGate and explain any failing checks.
Check this repository before I commit.
